title: BundleTool manifest, schemaVersion 1
description: What the BundleTool command line reads. The same shape is exported and imported by the browser tool. Keys not listed at the top level, in a section or in a file entry are rejected (error code unknown_key). Unknown keys inside config are ignored with a warning (unknown_config_key), because the settings grow and shrink between versions.

schemaVersion.description: Optional. When present it must be 1.

config.description: Settings as flat "group.field" keys, for example "heading.bundleTitle". Groups: heading, index, pageNumbering, page, pageOptions, cover, ocr. Set pageOptions.generateCover to true to draw the cover maker's page from the cover.* fields. ocr.autoDetect has no effect here: it is the browser's own setting. The command line's OCR switch is ocr.mode (auto or off); a file's own "forceOcr" overrides it per document. index.dateInputOrder (UK or US) likewise has no effect here: it is the browser's own setting for reading an ambiguous date out of a file name; a document's date here is taken as given. ocr.turnUpright and ocr.straighten (true or false, both false by default) turn a sideways scanned page upright and straighten a tilted one as OCR reads it; they change only scanned pages OCR reads. pageOptions.smallerPhotos (true or false, true by default) puts each JPEG or PNG made into a page into the bundle at most 2000 pixels on its long edge; a PDF is never changed. The command line lists every key with its default when run with --config-keys.

coversheet.description: Optional. The name of a PDF inside the documents directory whose first page is the cover. It wins over a generated cover.

sectionID.description: Optional. Four digits, unique per section. Left out, sections are numbered by position: 0000, 0001, and so on.

filename.description: A plain file name inside the documents directory, no folder in front of it. A PDF, or a JPEG or PNG photo (read from the file's own bytes, not its extension), which becomes one page of the bundle's page size.

title.description: Optional. Left out, null or blank, the title is filled in from the filename, the same as when a title field is cleared on the page.

pageCount.description: Ignored: the real page count is read from the file.

rotate.description: Optional. Turn every page of this document clockwise by this many degrees, added to any rotation the file already carries.

forceOcr.description: Optional, default false. true runs OCR on every page of this document regardless of its own text layer, overriding ocr.mode for this file only.
